summary: The list of every op family Tokamax ships on main (tokamax/_src/ops): attention, flex_attention, ragged_dot grouped matmul, ragged gather/scatter, gated linear unit, normalization, fused linear softmax cross-entropy, causal conv1d gated delta rule, triangle multiplication, and experimental TPU kernels. The starting point for whether a Tokamax kernel already exists for an op; each op's own directory says whether it has a TPU kernel.
note: A live GitHub directory listing, so it shows what Tokamax ships on main today; TPU coverage is read off the file names. tpu-kernel-development asks for it before building a kernel Tokamax may already have.

summary: Tokamax dot-product (flash) attention: forward and backward. Has a TPU kernel (pallas_mosaic_tpu.py, pallas_mosaic_tpu_vjp.py), plus GPU kernels for SM90/SM100 and Triton, and an XLA chunked fallback. A `pallas_mosaic_tpu*` file is a TPU Pallas kernel; `pallas_triton*`, `pallas_mosaic_gpu*`, `triton` and `cutedsl` files are GPU-only.
